facts.zh: 多款面食和麻婆豆腐饭明确有素食选项，其他部分菜品标有V。
facts.en: Noodle choices and mapo tofu on rice explicitly include vegetarian options; other menu items carry V labels.

facts.zh: 每周七天接受订位，最多可提前90天；超过10人须电话订位。
facts.en: The restaurant accepts reservations seven days a week up to 90 days ahead and asks parties of over 10 to book by phone.

places.cuisineEn: Korean charcoal BBQ buffet and fried chicken

occasions.whyEn: The booking policy explicitly accommodates groups of 12 or more adults.

occasions.whyZh: 12名及以上成人订位有明确订金政策。
occasions.whyEn: Bookings of 12 or more adults have a stated deposit policy.

occasions.whyZh: 自助餐有儿童年龄分档，三岁及以下免费。
occasions.whyEn: The buffet has children's age bands and free dining for ages three and under.

facts.zh: 市议会资料列 Tongkun位于 Hamilton Central的 Victoria Street 161号；酒牌许可时间不作为营业时间。
facts.en: Hamilton City Council identifies Tongkun Korean BBQ at 161 Victoria Street, Hamilton Central 3204; licence hours are not treated as trading hours.

facts.zh: 提供韩式炭火烤肉、炸鸡、拌饭和小菜，用餐限时90分钟。
facts.en: Offers Korean charcoal BBQ, fried chicken, bibimbap and side dishes; seating is limited to 90 minutes.

facts.zh: 须至少提前五小时预订；12名及以上成人的订单，每位在册客人均需付10纽币订金。
facts.en: Book at least five hours ahead. For 12 or more adults, a NZ$10-per-person deposit applies to every guest in the booking.

facts.zh: 儿童分4至7岁及8至12岁收费，三岁及以下免费；官网要求家长看护儿童，注意炭火。
facts.en: Children are priced in ages 4–7 and 8–12 bands; ages three and under are free. The site requires children to be supervised around hot charcoal.

facts.zh: 官网另列每人10纽币环保附加费，未完整说明具体收取条件。
facts.en: The site also lists an environmental surcharge of NZ$10 per person without fully explaining its charging trigger.

perks.name: Valentines Hamilton
perks.conditionsZh: 生日当天使用，须出示生日证明、加入会员，并与另外三位全价客人同行；无须预订。
perks.conditionsEn: On the birthday; bring birthday proof, belong to the loyalty programme and dine with three other full-paying guests; no booking required.

perks.name: BurgerFuel VIB Club
perks.where: Hamilton stores include Five Cross Roads, Frankton, Rototuna and Te Rapa (locations: https://www.burgerfuel.com/nz/locations)
perks.perkZh: 长期常客可获免费汉堡；新会员或较少光顾者获汉堡买一送一。
perks.perkEn: Regular longstanding members get a free burger; new/infrequent members get a birthday 2-for-1 offer.
perks.conditionsZh: 须为活跃会员，填写正确生日并至少提前 24 小时加入。仅生日当天使用一次，售完为止，不含改配，不可叠加，可能须查证件。优惠由消费活跃度决定；官网对买一送一适用款式的说明不一致，以收到的券为准。
perks.conditionsEn: Active member with correct birthdate, joined at least 24 hours before birthday. Birthday only, once, while stocks last; no customisations or combining offers; ID may be required. Engagement determines offer; eligible 2-for-1 burgers conflict within the page, so check the issued voucher.

perks.name: Star Social
perks.where: The Roaming Giant (789 Heaphy Terrace, Claudelands, Hamilton) and The Wayward Pigeon (2a Gordonton Road, Hamilton)
perks.perkZh: 生日券：Rising Star 30 纽币、Super Star 50 纽币、Mega Star 75 纽币、Social Star 100 纽币。
perks.perkEn: Birthday voucher: Rising Star NZ$30, Super Star NZ$50, Mega Star NZ$75, Social Star NZ$100.
perks.conditionsZh: 由 Star Hospitality Group Limited运营。须为会员，生日券金额按等级。常见问题页称生日月月初发券，条款称前一个月首日发券，两者不一致。限参与门店使用，有效期以应用内显示为准，须一次用完，余额不保留。
perks.conditionsEn: Owned and operated by Star Hospitality Group Limited. Membership required; voucher value depends on tier. The FAQ says issue at the start of the birthday month, while the terms say the first day of the preceding month. Terms require use at participating venues, app-displayed expiry and redemption in one transaction with no remaining balance carried forward.

perks.name: Columbus Coffee Rewards
perks.where: Columbus Coffee at Mitre 10 MEGA Te Rapa, Hamilton (branch: https://www.columbuscoffee.co.nz/find-a-store/columbus-coffee-at-mitre-10-mega-te-rapa)
perks.perkZh: 生日赠券；会员页未说明面额或具体赠品。
perks.perkEn: A birthday voucher; its value and contents are not specified on the rewards page.
perks.conditionsZh: 须注册 Columbus Rewards；所查会员页未说明生日券有效期、最低消费或注册截止时间。
perks.conditionsEn: Register for Columbus Rewards. The opened rewards page does not specify the birthday voucher's expiry, minimum spend or signup deadline.

perks.name: Starbucks Rewards NZ
perks.perkZh: Green：一次标准饮品改配；Gold：任意杯型手调饮品一杯，含最多两项标准改配；Reserve：手调饮品一杯及食品一份，总值最多 20 纽币。
perks.perkEn: Green: one standard drink customisation; Gold: one handcrafted drink of any size with up to two standard customisations; Reserve: one handcrafted drink plus one food item, combined maximum NZ$20.
perks.conditionsZh: 须保存生日并提前符合等级条件。Green 须至少提前七天加入，且生日之前有一笔不少于 10 纽币的合资格消费。生日开始的兑换期：Green 一天、Gold 七天、Reserve 30 天；Reserve 须同一笔兑换，可到店或通过应用兑换。
perks.conditionsEn: Save birthdate and meet tier eligibility before birthday. Green requires joining seven days ahead and a prior eligible NZ$10+ transaction. Redemption windows from birthday: Green one day, Gold seven days, Reserve 30 days; Reserve items in one transaction. In-store/app redemption.

perks.name: Muffin Break Rewards NZ
perks.perkEn: One free muffin during the birthday month.
perks.conditionsZh: 须在生日月之前在线注册会员；生日月内才注册，要等到下一年。须在生日月内兑换，并出示及扫描已注册会员卡。
perks.conditionsEn: Register the loyalty account online before the birthday month; registering during that month defers the reward until next year. Redeem during the birthday month; present/scan the registered rewards card (card rule: https://muffinbreak.co.nz/muffin-break-club-terms-conditions/).

perks.name: Daikoku Hamilton
perks.perkZh: 生日优惠：点四份主菜时，最便宜的一份免费。
perks.perkEn: Birthday promotion: when four mains are ordered, the cheapest main is free.
perks.conditionsZh: 用餐时须出示证件证明当日生日，不可与其他优惠同用。当前汉密尔顿菜单链接此2026年8月传单，未列截止日期及其他排除条件。
perks.conditionsEn: Present ID proving it is your birthday when dining. Cannot combine with other discounts or promotions. The current Hamilton menu index links this August 2026 flyer; it gives no end date or further exclusions.
